visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Set a class instead of many styles
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The script sets three style properties one by one. Define a class with those styles and add it with classList. The box must look the same after the click.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Box

solution.code: Box
solution.explanation: Styles belong in CSS, and the script only decides when to apply them. A class can be changed by a designer without touching the JavaScript.

checks.label: After a click the box is tomato
After a click the text is white
After a click the padding is 10px
